summary: ArcelorMittal (issuer) filed a Form 6-K announcing the completion of the first tranche and commencement of the second tranche of its 2025–2030 share buyback programme. The first tranche repurchased 10 million shares at an average price of €49.32 per share; the second tranche targets up to 10 million shares. Repurchased shares are held in treasury pending cancellation. The programme aims to reduce capital and meet employee share obligations, with execution dependent on post-dividend free cash flow (minimum 50% returned) and market conditions. The filing is a routine capital return update with no premium or advisor disclosure; monitor continued buyback pace and shareholder authorization.
